summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K to correct an inadvertent error in its Form 40-F registration statement, which had incorrectly stated its jurisdiction of incorporation as Ontario instead of British Columbia, Canada. The correction was made via Amendment No. 2 to the registration statement, which the company subsequently requested to withdraw, and this 6-K was furnished to reflect the correction in the Exchange Act reporting record. No other information was corrected. This is a purely administrative filing with no special-situation implications.
